$comment: Copy to scripts/import-mapping.json (git-ignored: it holds real balances and names) and adapt it. Categories are grouped by type (EXPENSE = sheet Gastos, INCOME = sheet Ingresos); the same name may exist in both. Keys are the exact names used in the Excel. Icons and colors are arbitrary; subcategory colors are derived from the parent color.

expectedBalances.$comment: Real final balance (EUR) of each account. Simulation and execution must match it exactly.

loans.$comment: A loan expense gets a subcategory only when its comment starts with '<Name>:' and <Name> is one of the category subcategories. Otherwise it stays in the category without subcategory.
